solutionSearchEvidence: Current screen-navigation-core already owns destination-aware transition families and multi-surface ENTER animation with whole-screen fallback.
Current piece selectors cover Cards, Characters, Setup, Shop and Gacha but not Profile or Partner, although both are registered motion destinations.

Current Profile runtime exposes stable profileIdentitySummary/profileRecordsNote/profileActions regions; current Partner shell exposes stable title plus active/menu/list/detail/formation/strategy/dialogue/costume/navigation regions.
P5X cross-screen source scope is stored in existing UIVIS and requires reuse across materially relevant screens, not a Home-only or second-engine implementation.
Battle is deliberately excluded from this slice because it already has specialized presentation motion and adding generic screen pieces risks double animation.
